maddeler.e:
ننمحي (form VII)
# نَنْمَحِي (nanmaḥī) /nan.ma.ħiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْمَحَى (inmaḥā)
# نَنْمَحِيَ (nanmaḥiya) /nan.ma.ħi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْمَحَى (inmaḥā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
